sections.description: From large-batch drying to high-temperature curing and industrial heat treatment, the OF3 Series suits industrial, materials, chemical and high-throughput laboratories.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the OF3 Series include 314 to 760 L volumes, temperatures to 200 C (OF3) or 300 C (H) and simple-control twin-fan forced convection.

Controller: bright VFD display with quick adjustable dial knob (General model) - shows set and present values at once. Two sirocco fans; microprocessor PID with 3-point calibration and auto-tuning. Technical data per DIN 12880; CE for 380V 50/60 Hz. Each model is available with a solid or window door (optional threefold tempered glass). The General model offers simple, quick control - for multi-step programming and scheduling, see the OF3-P program model. Cat. Nos.: OF3-30 AAH18215K (solid, 230V) / AAH18315K (window); larger and H models use 380V 3-phase catalog numbers. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

sections.title: Control and Safety System
body: The OF3 Series pairs a simple VFD controller with PID precision and comprehensive safety.

groups.title: Control
items: Bright VFD display with quick adjustable dial knob; set and present values shown at once.
Microprocessor PID with 3-point calibration and automatic tuning.
Three preset temperatures for common settings.
Dual wait on/off timer modes (1 min to 99 h 59 min).

groups.title: Safety
items: Keypad lock prevents accidental changes during operation.
Automatic run after power interruption.
Over-temperature and over-current protection.
Audible and visible open-door alarms; safe outer surface at maximum temperature.

groups.title: Data and Connectivity
items: USB and RS-232 ports for external control and data collection.
Optional 6-point or thermal-line recorder; LC GreenBox for mobile monitoring (up to 4 units).
